The modifications establish a synchronization mechanism to prevent race conditions between virtchnl message handling and VF ndo operations. By introducing a mutex (`cfg_lock`) in the `ice_vf` structure, the patch ensures that when a VF ndo operation is in progress (which may involve resetting the VF), any incoming virtchnl messages that pertain to that VF are ignored if they cannot acquire the mutex.
